model_annotation: The diagram depicts a bar graph comparing the sensitivity of 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit across various block indices. The horizontal axis represents the block index, with values ranging from 0 to 27, marked at intervals of approximately 6 units, while the vertical axis represents sensitivity on a logarithmic scale, spanning from $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-3}$. Each set consists of 9 bars, with the height of each bar indicating the sensitivity value on the vertical axis. The blue bars exhibit a general upward trend from left to right, with the first blue bar at approximately $10^{-4}$ and the last blue bar reaching nearly $10^{-3}$. In contrast, the green bars are generally lower in height, with the tallest green bar around $10^{-4}$ and most green bars below $10^{-5}$. No specific sorting or highlighting is applied to the bars, and no additional annotations are present on the graph.

model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the sensitivity of 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit across various block indices. The chart features two sets of bars, one in blue representing 4-Fbit and the other in green representing 2-Fbit. For 2-Fbit, the bar at block index 0 has a sensitivity of approximately 0.00015, and multiple bars have a sensitivity of approximately 0.00005. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
